## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` is green locally (format, lint, types, tests, client build)
- [ ] Every new or changed figure shows its source, licence, observed time and fetched time
- [ ] New adapter: recorded fixture (or a synthetic one if the terms forbid redistribution), fixture tests, freshness budget, licence, and `bun scripts/gen-docs.ts` run (see docs/ADAPTERS.md)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, personal data or local paths in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] User-facing text in Spanish first, English through `t(es, en)`
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
